messages.subject: Damian | Energy & Natural Resources Executive Profile | ESG, Government Relations & Transition
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Goodburn,

I am sharing my profile for senior international leadership mandates across energy, natural resources, mining and the transition economy.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My portfolio covers government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, compliance coordination and executive communications for a major gold-mining operation.

My current exposure also includes a large renewable-energy platform supporting mining operations, with approximately 46-50 MWp of solar and more than 80 MWh of battery storage, alongside climate and carbon-data work.

Given your leadership of Sheffield Haworth's global Energy practice and work on ExCo mandates across energy, renewables, sustainability and transition, I would value confidential consideration for Director, Senior Director, Head, Country Director and VP-track mandates spanning External Affairs, Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships and Country Leadership.

I have attached a tailored executive CV. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice, with Saudi Arabia and the UAE as priority markets.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
